title: Ancarion living-portrait clips
provenance: These clips are AI-generated (Kling AI image-to-video) from the owner's own painting, web/src/assets/canonreeve.webp. The painting itself was not altered; no other source imagery was used. The raw MP4s also carry Kling's AIGC metadata tag.

uploaded_as.note: lossless WebP-to-PNG conversion (Kling accepts only PNG/JPG); decoded pixels verified identical; uploaded bytes verified identical by re-download

local_only: raw/ and ancarion-poster.png are kept on the author's machine (gitignored); the committed WebM/MP4 encodes are what scripts/prepare-portrait-video.mjs copies into web/src/assets.

asleep_keyframe.from: frame 53 (2.21 s) of raw/ancarion-accept.mp4, scaled to 760x760 (lanczos); approved by the owner. Ships on the site as web/src/assets/ancarion-asleep.webp.

web_encodes.mp4: H.264 High (libx264 slow CRF 18), yuv420p, +faststart, no audio, 1440x1440

Locked-off static camera. Keep the brushwork, colors and composition exactly; only he moves.
